title: Support The Carrier Always (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl fiddle steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the carrier is never alone
Support runners on both shoulders, close to home
Within two metres, ready for the offload

[Verse 1]
When a teammate carries the ball, run with them
One support on the inside shoulder, one on the outside hem
Within reach for the offload pass
Never leave the carrier without a brass

[Pre-Chorus]
Match the pace of the ball carrier exactly
Never ahead, never behind, run abreast tactly
Hands ready, palms up, fingers spread
Waiting for the offload, get fed

[Chorus]
Support the carrier always, son
Within two metres, the work begun
Inside shoulder, outside shoulder, both
Offload waiting, take the growth

[Verse 2]
The second wave runs five metres deep
Ready to take the next pass in a sweep
Second phase support, the cleanout crew
First arrive, the ruck is your view

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, no man stands alone in rugby
Fifteen as one, every phase, every snug
If the carrier looks up and sees no one
The attack is dead, son, the work is undone

[Chorus]
Support the carrier always, son
Within two metres, the work begun
Inside shoulder, outside shoulder, both
Offload waiting, take the growth

[Outro]
Never alone, the carrier
Two metres close, two shoulders carrier
Hands up, palms ready
Thats my boy, support steady
